title: Itaipu Dam
summary: Itaipu is a dam on the Paraná River on the Brazil-Paraguay border, built jointly under a 1973 treaty that gave both countries equal ownership. Construction began in 1975 and ended in 1984. The dam is 196 m high and, by the plant's own technical data, 7,919 m long. Building it took 50 million cubic metres of excavation and 12.3 million cubic metres of concrete.

uncertainty.note: Start (1975) and completion (1984) are given by IEEE Spectrum; the Itaipu tourism page also dates the first works to 1975 and the start of generation to 1984. End is the present: the plant operates.
